decision: 5 second time penalty imposed after the Sprint.
offence: Breach of Article 34.14 a) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video and in-car video evidence. Car 87 was released into the path of Car 27 which was arriving in the fast lane, causing Car 27 to brake and take evasive action.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 87 Unsafe Release From A Pit Stop
